candidate.claim: Empty-extglob detection checks ast.#parts.length which is always 0 before ast.push(...parts,part), so !(a|) with trailing empty alternative is misclassified as empty !() and compiled to starNoEmpty.
candidate.title: Empty extglob misdetected when ending with |

verifier.reason: The check at ast.ts:499 tests ast.#parts.length before ast.push(...parts, part) at ast.ts:504, while prior alternatives are accumulated only in the local parts array at ast.ts:494, so for !(a|) acc is '' and ast.#parts is still empty, incorrectly setting ast.#emptyExt at ast.ts:500.

candidate.claim: After splicing adopted children into parent, code updates p.#parent but never updates p.#parentIndex, leaving stale indices that break isStart/isEnd checks for moved parts.
candidate.title: Adopted AST parts keep stale parentIndex

verifier.reason: The excerpt at ast.ts:579-582 shows #adopt splicing gc.#parts and updating only p.#parent, but the provided excerpts contain no #parentIndex declaration or assignment, no isStart/isEnd definitions, and no #adopt call sites or post-adoption re-indexing, so whether stale indices persist or affect those checks cannot be settled from the given context.
